Further, all cases that were originally adjudicated by the Regional Provident Fund 
Commissioner-I (RPFC-1) or Regional Provident Fund Commissioner-II (RPFC-11) in charge of the 
Region and subsequently remanded by any Court or Tribunal for fresh adjudication under Sections 125 
or 128, shall be reheard and disposed of by the RPFC-1 or RPFC-11 (OIC) as the case may be, of the 
concerned Regional Office. 
Nothing in this circular shall apply to proceedings under Sections 125 and 128 in respect of 
establishments undergoing proceedings under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Such 
proceedings shall continue to be governed by the circular dated 17.03.2026 issued by the IBBI Cell, 
and shall not be reassigned on the basis of the subscriber-strength criteria prescribed in the circular 
dated 13.07.2026 or the instant circular. 
Except to the extent modi tied herein, all other provisions of the Circular dated 13.07.2026 shat I 
remain unchanged and continue to be in force. 
All existing cases shall be re-assigned by OICs of the ROs latest by 07.08.2026 on the above 
noted parameters and a confirmation in this regard may be sent to Head office through Zonal Office. 
Strict adherence to the dir~ctions in this regard must be ensured. 
(This issues with the approval of the CPFC) 
Yours faithfully, 
(P. B. Verma)
